findings.label: Race tests don't force the interleaving
findings.issue: The transition concurrency tests (Promise.all) and the PATCH race tests (sleep(300) before committing the held lock) depend on scheduling. On a slow runner they can pass without the requests overlapping, so a regression to read-then-write would only fail intermittently.
findings.action: Optional: before committing the held transaction, wait until the PATCH or second transition is observably blocked (e.g. poll performance_schema.data_lock_waits / information_schema.innodb_trx) instead of sleeping.

findings.label: loginIp is a global bucket behind the proxy (tracked)
findings.issue: With TRUST_PROXY=0 behind the Next.js proxy, req.ip is the proxy's address, so 50 failed logins from anyone return 429 to every user for 15 minutes.
findings.action: Complete the Phase 7 checklist item (key loginIp on the real client IP and verify on the deployed chain) before release.
